desc:
Start small and grow into a score-generating powerhouse! In Road to Infinity Incremental, every click, upgrade, and strategy choice pushes you closer to unstoppable progress. Watch your numbers skyrocket as you unlock powerful boosts and automate your circles!

💰 Earn score passively
⚙️ Unlock powerful upgrades
📈 Multiply your growth
🚀 Progress even while offline

Reinvest your score wisely, discover game-changing upgrades, and create the ultimate Incremental empire. The Circle never stops — even when you log off. 

This is a 3D idle game heavily inspired by the mechanics of Revolution Idle. All 3D assets, scripts, and UI were created from scratch for this experience. It's a project for me to learn how to code in Lua , UI design and use BIG NUM library.

Huge shoutout to 'Revolution Idle' on the Play Store !
